art_direction: 竹帘窗前一只茶盏冒着细雾，窗外雨丝与远屋檐层次柔和。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create an intimate ink interior with one ceramic teacup on a dark wooden sill beside a partly rolled bamboo blind. Steam rises in reserved pale curves and merges with the rain-lit window. Beyond the glass, suggest one distant tiled roof and a blurred tree through layered ink washes. Use small mineral-blue accents in the cup glaze and warm brown in the sill. Place the cup centrally so it remains the main icon; keep the blind cords, raindrops, and distant architecture secondary. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
